# pai skill

How your skills are used

```
pai skill <command>
```

Skills are reusable instructions a session can load. `pai skill telemetry` shows which ones were triggered and when.

```sh
pai skill telemetry
pai skill telemetry --status active --json
```

See also: `pai audit skills`

### pai skill telemetry

Which skills were used, when, and where

```
pai skill telemetry [options]
```

Lists skills with their trigger counts, last use and projects. Output with --json is the raw data.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--scope NAME` | string | default | Governance scope to read |
| `--status STATE` | string | — | Only skills in this state: trial, active or archived |
| `--limit N` | number | 50 | Maximum rows |
| `--json` | flag | — | Output raw JSON |

```sh
pai skill telemetry
pai skill telemetry --status trial --limit 10
pai skill telemetry --json
```

See also: `pai audit skills`
